name: createDeviceFarmUpload
description: Create an AWS Device Farm upload slot and return a pre-signed upload URL. Server records temporary upload metadata (TTL: 2h) so successful uploads can refresh per-project ARN cache.

projectArn.description: Device Farm project ARN (optional if configured in config.yaml)

name.description: Upload filename shown in Device Farm, e.g. app-debug.apk

type.description: Device Farm upload type, e.g. ANDROID_APP or APPIUM_NODE_TEST_PACKAGE
